verses.1: And Shemuel took the ointment and applied it on his head. Then he said, “May the LORD anoint you as king over his land.”
verses.2: As you walked today, you came across two men with Rachel’s remains at the border of Benyamin. They said to you, “We have found the remains that you were looking for. But your father has forgotten to mention these remains in his words. He is worried about what he should do with them.”
verses.3: And you went there, and it was beautiful. You arrived at those ruins. There, you found three men who were going to the temple of God. One of them carried three loaves of bread, another carried six coins, and the third carried a golden vessel.
verses.4: And they asked you for compensation. So they gave you two loaves of bread. You took them from their hands.
verses.5: Then, the army of God will come. There, those who are from Philistia will be defeated. The city will be destroyed. Then, the prophets will descend from the heavens. Before them will be Nebel, Toph, Halil, and Kinnor. They will be brought down from heaven.
verses.6: And the spirit of Jehovah came upon you, and you became one with them. You were transformed into another person.
verses.7: And it shall be that when these signs come to you, do what your hand finds to do, for God is with you.
verses.8: And you shall go down into the valley. Then I will come to you, and we will offer the sacrifices of peace offerings for seven days, starting from the day when I come to you. And I will tell you what you must do.
verses.9: And it happened that, in his attempt to go with Shemuel, he became like a god himself. He became another god. And all these gods came together on that day.
verses.10: And there they came, and behold, there were ropes leading to the place where he was to be taken. But a spirit of God fell upon him, and he was carried into their midst.
verses.11: And everyone who knew about this became terrified. They saw that there were prophets coming down from heaven. The people said to each other, “What could have happened to the boy Kish? Why did Shemuel also become one of those prophets?”
verses.12: And someone from there said, “Who were their ancestors? That’s why Shem was the ruler over the people.”
verses.13: And he could no longer hide himself, and the army came in.
verses.14: And David said to him, “And to your young man as well, go with them. And he said to ask for those items. And it seems that Aiyn will come up to Shmuel.”
verses.15: And Dov Shaul said, “Please tell me what I should say to you.”
verses.16: And Shaul said to Dovid, “Tell us what has been found, and what the king said.” But Dovid did not tell him what Shemuel had said.
verses.17: And Shemuel cried out to the people, “To the LORD, the Almighty!”
verses.18: And he said to the children of Israel, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I have brought you out of Egypt, and I will save you from the hands of the Egyptians and from all those kings who are oppressing you.”
verses.19: And today, you have sinned against your gods, who are those who save you from all your evils and troubles. You said to them, “Let the king rule over us.” Now then, stand before Jehovah to rule over yourselves and over your people.
verses.20: And Shemuel brought together all the instruments of Israel. He collected all the utensils made of gold.
verses.21: And he brought the Ark of the Covenant before his families. Then the family of the Matherim gathered together. Shaul, son of Kish, was also among them. But they couldn’t find him anywhere.
verses.22: And still, God asked again. Once more, someone came forward and said, “Lord, see, he is lying in the graves.”
verses.23: And they desired to take him there. So they took him away from there. Then he stood among the people. He was raised above all the people, above their heads and shoulders.
verses.24: And Shemuel said to all the people, “Look at those whom Jehovah has chosen. There is no one like them among all the people.” But all the people rebelled against him. They said, “May the king live!”
verses.25: And Moses spoke to the people about the laws of judgment. He wrote them down in a book and handed them over to Jehovah. Then Moses sent each person back to their own homes.
verses.26: And Shaul also went to his house in Gibeah. The soldiers who were touched by God’s spirit went with him.
verses.27: And the sons of Belial said, “What can they do to save us?” They tried to deceive him, but they didn’t bring him any food. And so it happened as you know.
